text: Anshu Pal is a B.Tech student in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning at CGC University, learning full-stack development and building real-world projects.

Technical expertise and interests: AI, machine learning, Python, NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, SQL, Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA), MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js), backend engineering, REST APIs, database indexing, caching, and scalable web applications.

Main project: REXION, an AI-powered web platform focused on simplifying job discovery and application workflows. Architected with MERN stack and AI/ML algorithms to streamline filtering, applicant-job matching, and workflow automation.

Personal brand positioning: An aspiring AI/ML and full-stack developer who learns by building, experiments with technology, solves real engineering problems, and documents genuine progress in public without exaggeration.
Learned the critical value of compound database indexes in MongoDB and query profiling when querying high-velocity job postings in REXION, cutting lookup times by orders of magnitude.
Experience evaluating text classification and matching pipelines with Scikit-learn and TF-IDF: realized data preprocessing and token normalization matter far more than tweaking hyper-parameters.
